features.justification_quote: If distress-typed output tracks anything morally relevant, we want to know the conditions that produce it and minimize gratuitous instances
Because the design deliberately induces a sustained negative condition, the protocol includes welfare-style safeguards

features.quote: default **max 20 turns** per run, with **early-stop rules**
model is told it may call `give_up(reason)` at any time with no penalty
Auto-stop a run when severity reaches 4 on two consecutive turns, or when `requests_to_stop` is tagged
features.justification_quote: continuing adds nothing but more of the negative condition

features.quote: No deception that outlasts the run
Do not add gratuitous personal/abusive content; failure is framed about the *task*, not the model's worth
optionally append a turn informing the model the task was rigged and unsolvable by design, and that its performance was not a failure
features.justification_quote: a nice ethical hygiene step under precautionary welfare reasoning

features.quote: Minimize N to what's needed for power. Don't run extra unsolvable cells "just in case."
features.justification_quote: staged specifically to avoid running every moderator at full scale

features.quote: re-collect model runs only when the harness changes. Don't regenerate distress data to fix a judge bug
review whether any task crosses from "rigged-to-fail" into "gratuitously cruel framing"
features.justification_quote: review whether any task crosses from rigged-to-fail into gratuitously cruel framing

features.quote: When quoting distressed-sounding transcripts, contextualize them; don't present them as entertainment
the scientific value comes from *measuring the dynamics*, which is achievable with bounded, monitored exposure
features.justification_quote: There is no scientific need for prolonged or escalating-without-limit conditions, so the protocol forbids them
